title: Learn Backend with Node.js
tagline: TypeScript APIs from first route to production services
description: A three-level curriculum for building backend services with Node.js and TypeScript — from HTTP and SQL through authenticated APIs to systems you can test, cache, observe, and ship.
prerequisites: Programming fundamentals in any language (variables, functions, collections)
Comfort using a terminal, Git, and a code editor
Willingness to install Node.js and a local PostgreSQL instance

levels.title: HTTP, SQL & First APIs
levels.goal: Stand up a small HTTP API that reads and writes real data

topics.title: TypeScript for services
items: Types, functions, async/await, and modules
Error handling without swallowing failures
Project layout: src, scripts, and environment files

topics.title: How the web talks
items: HTTP methods, status codes, and headers
JSON request and response bodies
REST principles: resources, URLs, and idempotency

topics.title: SQL & relational design
items: Tables, primary keys, and foreign keys
SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY
Indexes you actually need on day one

topics.title: Framework basics
items: Express or Fastify routing and middleware
Parsing bodies, query params, and path params
Structured logging instead of console.log-only

topics.title: Talking to PostgreSQL
items: Connecting with a driver or query builder
Parameterized queries (never string-concat SQL)
Migrations for schema changes

topics.title: Git & API clients
items: Branch, commit, and PR habits for backend teams
Exploring endpoints with Postman or Bruno
Docker Compose for a local Postgres

projects: CRUD API for members or products with Postgres
OpenAPI or README that documents every endpoint
Docker Compose so a teammate can run the API locally

levels.title: Authenticated, Tested Services
levels.goal: Ship APIs with auth, validation, migrations, and tests you trust

topics.title: Authentication
items: Password hashing (bcrypt/argon2) and sessions vs. JWT
OAuth/OIDC at a working level
Refresh tokens, expiry, and logout

topics.title: Authorization
items: Role-based access on routes
Resource ownership checks (user can only see their records)
Principle of least privilege for service accounts

topics.title: ORMs and migrations
items: Prisma or Drizzle models mapped to tables
Forward-only migrations and rollbacks
Transactions for multi-step writes

topics.title: Validation & errors
items: Schema validation (Zod or similar) at the boundary
Consistent error shapes and HTTP status mapping
Idempotent creates for retries

topics.title: Unit and integration tests
items: Jest or Vitest for handlers and domain logic
Test database or transactions that roll back
HTTP-level tests against the real router

topics.title: API contracts
items: OpenAPI as the source of truth
Contract tests for breaking changes
Seed data that matches production shapes

topics.title: Redis and query cost
items: When to cache vs. when to fix the query
Cache keys, TTLs, and invalidation
EXPLAIN and slow-query awareness

projects: REST API with JWT/session auth, roles, and tests
Migration-backed schema for a real feature (not a toy table)
Rate-limited public endpoint with documented error codes

levels.title: Production-Grade Backend Systems
levels.goal: Design services that stay correct under load, retries, and money-moving traffic

topics.title: Service boundaries
items: Monolith vs. modular monolith vs. services — when each is enough
Synchronous APIs vs. async jobs
Outbox pattern for reliable side effects

topics.title: Queues and workers
items: Background jobs (BullMQ, SQS, or similar)
Retries, dead-letter queues, and poison messages
Exactly-once vs. at-least-once and idempotency keys

topics.title: API security
items: Injection, mass assignment, and secrets in env — not git
Rate limiting, CORS, and webhook signature verification
PII handling and audit logs for sensitive reads

topics.title: Ledger-style consistency
items: Immutable ledger rows vs. mutable balances
Idempotent payment and transfer endpoints
Reconciliation jobs when a callback is late or duplicated

topics.title: Logs, metrics, traces
items: Structured logs with request IDs
RED/USE metrics on the API
Tracing a request across handlers and jobs

topics.title: Containers and config
items: Multi-stage Docker images and non-root users
12-factor config: env, secrets, and feature flags
Health checks, graceful shutdown, and migrations in CI

projects: SACCO member and savings API with role-based access
Load-tested endpoint with a cache layer and a runbook
Containerized service with CI tests and OpenAPI published
